newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds remain firm, buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds remain firm, buyers sidelined.

text.p: Prices on the UK meals and feeds market remained firm on Tuesday following a further rally on the Chicago futures market, but buyers were keeping well away.
"People don't have to buy and they certainly won't at these prices," said a broker.
Brokers said there was some concern on the supply of corn gluten, but this was not a major factor yet.
"Some people are getting a bit worried about the low number of ships arriving and it is a situation that will need watching in the coming weeks," said another broker.
High protein soymeal was offered ex-mill Seaforth at two to five stg a tonne up from Monday while Brazilian 48's were unchanged.
On the east coast high pro was around 0.50 stg up form the stores.
Rapemeal from the Erith mill was unchanged while material from the Liverpool and Hull mills was one to two stg higher.
Resellers of Erith material were unchanged.
Sunflower pellets ex-Erith were unchanged while imported EU meal was as much a five stg a tonne higher on the east coast.
Corn gluten prices ranged from unchanged to three stg up.
In light trading high protein soymeal fetched 228 stg a tonne for spot ex-store Avonmouth while resellers sold A.D.M. rapemeal bookings at 123 stg a tonne.
